sourceExceptions.finding: The source uses opposite subtraction conventions for 原価率差異 versus ロス率, labels a negative loss 逆ざや, and prints an extra ×100 after already-percent rates in one diagram.
sourceExceptions.decision: Preserve explicit subtraction order and percentage-point units in app; do not import ambiguous source labels or double multiplication.

sourceExceptions.finding: The old source includes cloth-over-burning-oil, water-based extinguishing examples, putting a large plastic bag over the face, and a sequence that may delay customer evacuation or encourage document retrieval.
sourceExceptions.decision: Do not restore these as general instructions. App prioritizes a usable exit, emergency contact, smoke avoidance and no return for possessions. Full current-authority emergency/domain review remains pending.

sourceExceptions.finding: Blanket every-store fire-manager placement and annual drill wording need applicable building/use/current rules; app adds qualification and building-context caveats.
sourceExceptions.decision: Do not downgrade conditional app wording to the old blanket rule. Precise drill frequency is still a genuine gap and needs primary current-authority review.

sourceExceptions.finding: Source generalizations include clearing every empty plate without confirmation, tasting an off-taste complaint, or following companion wishes when illness occurs.
sourceExceptions.decision: Preserve confirmation of customer intent, no tasting suspect contamination, and emergency instructions/trained action. Not a new medical certification.

sourceExceptions.finding: Source says fresh fish can be raw, makes a blanket statement about raw-use frozen greens, and describes limited statutory safety obligations using its historical context.
sourceExceptions.decision: Do not teach freshness as pathogen/parasite clearance, a universal frozen-product rule, or absence of all workplace duties; retain product/specification and safe-work controls.
